<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="4" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-3" id="vboQ2Agw4rTyRop0v7mM"> <mxGraphModel dx="2134" dy="658" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 direction TB

 class HoD {
 -String id
 -String name
 -String email
 +login()
 +inputTotalBudget(amount: float)
 +dragAndDropAssignment(ta: TA, course: Course, hours: int)
 +undoLastAssignment()
 }

 class Deputy {
 -String id
 -String name
 -String email
 +login()
 +viewBudgetAndAssignments()
 }

 class TA {
 -String id
 -String name
 -String email
 -float hourlyRate
 -float performanceRating
 +login()
 +getTotalAssignedHours() int
 +viewMySchedule()
 }

 class Course {
 -String courseId
 -String courseName
 -int totalWeeks
 -int currentEnrollment
 -float studentToTARatio
 +checkCapacityAlert()
 }

 class Assignment {
 -String assignmentId
 -int weeklyHours
 -int startWeek
 -int endWeek
 -String status
 +calculateTotalCost() float
 +getWorkedHours(currentWeek: int) int
 +getUnworkedHours(currentWeek: int) int
 }

 class BudgetPool {
 -float totalBudget
 -float remainingBudget
 +calculateRemainingBudget(assignments: List) float
 +processRefund(unworkedHours: int, rate: float)
 }

 %% Connections
 HoD \"1\" -- \"1\" BudgetPool : Manages and Inputs
 HoD \"1\" -- \"*\" Assignment : Creates Drag and Drop
 TA \"1\" -- \"*\" Assignment : Is Assigned To
 Course \"1\" -- \"*\" Assignment : Requires
 
 %% Deputy Connections (Read-Only)
 Deputy \"1\" ..> \"1\" BudgetPool : Views (Read-Only)
 Deputy \"1\" ..> \"*\" Assignment : Views (Read-Only)",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
